name: aether-office
description: Autonomous Multi-Agent AI Office & 2D Pixel Art Canvas Simulator

scripts.setup: uv venv --python 3.11 --clear && uv pip install -e ".[ui]" httpx httpx2 pytest pytest-cov pytest-asyncio || python -m venv .venv && .\.venv\Scripts\python.exe -m pip install -e ".[ui]" httpx httpx2 pytest pytest-cov pytest-asyncio
scripts.start: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); if(!fs.existsSync('.venv/Scripts/python.exe')){console.log('[*] Setting up environment with Python 3.11...'); require('child_process').execSync('npm run setup', {stdio:'inherit'});}" && .\.venv\Scripts\python.exe cli.py dashboard
scripts.dev: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); if(!fs.existsSync('.venv/Scripts/python.exe')){console.log('[*] Setting up environment with Python 3.11...'); require('child_process').execSync('npm run setup', {stdio:'inherit'});}" && .\.venv\Scripts\python.exe cli.py dashboard
